transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Could I ask each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements for the gala broadcast package? I want to make sure we address any issues before I sign off on the binding approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of this, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure it's officially captured before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights requirement to flag. The signed performance license I received this morning — which is now countersigned — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits any later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, so I want it officially captured now before final approval. This means the current draft package's allowance for reuse in the festival archive would violate the license if that reuse constitutes video-on-demand.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a critical talent requirement to flag. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not in the production schedule. This means the current draft package's plan for a sponsor product display on stage would violate the headliner's rider. The 3:00 PM soundcheck constraint also needs to be officially captured before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to flag. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet, so I want it officially captured before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
